 Order

Petitioners who are apprehending arrest in Crime No.170/2023 registered by Hubballi Sub-Urban Police Station, Hubballi, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 468, 471, read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short, 'IPC') are before this Court under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code (for short, 'Cr.P.C').
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. FIR in Crime No.170/2023 was registered by Hubballi Sub-Urban Police Station, Hubballi, for the aforesaid offences against the petitioners and others.

Apprehending arrest in the said case,
petitioners had filed Crl.Misc.No.5495/2023 before the Court of V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad sitting at Hubballi, NC: 2024:KHC-D:939 which was rejected against them on 08.12.2022.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, they are before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are not parties to the sale deed dated 12.09.2023 under which allegedly the property of the complainant was sold by impersonation.
He submits that petitioners are ready and willing to co-operate with the Police.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the bail application.
She submits that only notice under Section 41A of the Cr.P.C is issued and there cannot be any apprehension of arrest.

She however, fairly submits that petitioners are not parties to the sale deed dated 12.09.2023.
6.
The allegation in the complaint is that the property of complainant was sold under sale deed dated 12.09.2023 without his knowledge by impersonation.
Undisputedly petitioners are not parties to the aforesaid sale deed dated 12.09.2023, in any capacity.

sentences.text: The alleged offences in the FIR are triable by the jurisdictional Magistrate.
The maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment for a period of 07 years.
Petitioners have no criminal antecedents., I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioners for grant of anticipatory bail is required to be answered in the affirmative.

Accordingly the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

The respondent-Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.170/2023 registered by Hubballi Sub-Urban Police Station, Hubballi, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 468, 471, read with Section 34 of the IPC, subject to the following conditions :
(i) Petitioners shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- each with 01 NC: 2024:KHC-D:939 surety for the like-sum to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.

(ii) Petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
(iii) Petitioners shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses either directly or indirectly.
(iv) Petitioners shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer for the purpose of investigation in the case.
